text: Upon receiving petition from Killdeer Crescent residents, I conducted a survey with the affected households to allow parking on both sides of the street on the north end of Killdeer Crescent. Currently, parking is allowed only one side but residents have expressed concerns with lack of on-street parking. The poll resulted in favour of allowing parking on both sides of the street. The statutory three-hour parking limit will still be in effect.

North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the parking prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of the northerly east-west section of Killdeer Crescent, between Brentcliffe Road (north intersection) and a point 90 metres east.
